title: Source-verified equivalent scholarship evidence for Phase 4.3 evaluation only
verification_method: Compared the exact eligible seeded chunk text and source page text at reference date 2026-11-27; no independent reviewer was available.

cases.question: For Access Support, what GPA and unit load do I need?
required_facts: Access Support term GPA threshold is 2.50 or better (lower numeric GPA is stronger).
cases.original_excerpt: Access Support Grant: Term GPA must not exceed 2.50; carry at least 12 units and meet the fictional monthly household-income band of ₱30,000 or below.
cases.alternative_excerpt: Access Support Grant—GPA 2.50 or better, at least 12 units
cases.equivalence_justification: Both exact chunks identify Access Support and state the same GPA threshold and minimum unit load. Page 1 also states that lower GPA numbers are stronger, so '2.50 or better' is equivalent to 'must not exceed 2.50'. Income and benefit details are not required by this question.

cases.question: What GPA and prior-term service hours does the Community Service Award require?
required_facts: Community Service Award GPA threshold is 2.50 or better (lower numeric GPA is stronger).
At least 20 service hours from the prior term are required.
cases.original_excerpt: Community Service Award: Term GPA must not exceed 2.50; carry at least 12 units and complete at least 20 service hours during the previous term.
cases.alternative_excerpt: Community Service Award—GPA 2.50 or better, at least 12 units, 20 prior-term service hours
cases.equivalence_justification: The summary passage explicitly names Community Service Award and contains both asked-for facts, including the prior-term qualifier; the GPA direction is equivalent because the same passage explains that lower GPA numbers are stronger. The extra 12-unit condition does not conflict with or replace the requested facts.

cases.question: What is Lakbay's minimum unit load?
required_facts: Lakbay Academic Merit Award requires at least 15 units.
cases.original_excerpt: Lakbay Academic Merit Award: Term GPA must not exceed 1.75 on this scale; carry at least 15 units and have no failed courses.
cases.alternative_excerpt: Lakbay Academic Merit Award—term GPA 1.75 or better, at least 15 units, no failed courses;
cases.equivalence_justification: Both exact chunks identify Lakbay and state a minimum load of 15 units; page 1 additionally summarizes GPA and no-failed-course requirements, which do not contradict the requested unit minimum.
